selected_script.angle: Stop using a random dish bucket and weak hose rinse that leaves dirt on the paint; switch to one organized car wash kit with foam, mitt, wheel brush, towels, and the camo bucket.
selected_script.hook: I was washing my car like this and basically just moving dirt around.

script_record.style: realistic handheld UGC, driveway car wash, natural daylight, close-up texture shots, no captions or stickers baked into video
script_record.primary_wrong_use: Using a random bucket, old sponge, and plain hose rinse, causing visible dirt streaks and repeated re-wiping.
script_record.voiceover_full: I was washing my car like this and basically just moving dirt around. The old sponge, random bucket, and hose rinse never really got the grime out of the panels or the wheels. So I finally switched to the Chemical Guys 16-piece kit. The camo bucket has the Dirt Trap, the foam blaster hooks up for a foamy wash, and everything I kept looking for is already in one spot. I used the mitt on the paint, the brush on the wheels, wiped the glass and interior, then finished with the towels. Way less guessing, way more satisfying. If you like washing your own car, this kit makes it feel organized.

scene_01.visuals: Close-up of a dirty car door and lower panel in a sunny driveway. A hand uses an old generic sponge from a plain household bucket; the sponge drags across the panel and leaves gray streaks and bits of road grime. Cut to a wheel where plain hose water runs over brake dust but the wheel still looks dull. Keep the moment familiar, not exaggerated or unsafe.
scene_01.spoken_line: I was washing my car like this and basically just moving dirt around.
scene_01.on_screen_action: Old sponge smears dirt, plain bucket water looks cloudy, car panel still has visible streaking.
scene_01.camera: Phone-shot close-ups, slight handheld movement, low angle on car paint and wheel, natural driveway sound.
scene_01.product_visibility: Do not show the Chemical Guys kit yet.

scene_02.role: natural product entry and solution setup
scene_02.visuals: Creator steps to the garage shelf or driveway mat and pulls in the Chemical Guys 16-piece kit. Show the limited edition blue-white-black-gray camo bucket with the large circular Chemical Guys logo facing camera. Arrange real included items around it: green and black TORQ Foam Blaster 6 Pro with clear reservoir, Mr Pink bottle, Butter Wet Wax yellow bottle, Total Interior Cleaner blue spray bottle, Tire Kicker, Streak-Free Glass Cleaner, Sticky Citrus Wheel Cleaner orange spray bottle, green chenille wash mitt, blue microfiber towels, blue applicator pads, green wheel brush, black Dirt Trap disc. No extra tools.
scene_02.spoken_line: So I finally switched to the Chemical Guys 16-piece kit.
scene_02.on_screen_action: Hand places the camo bucket down, drops the black Dirt Trap into the bucket, picks up the foam blaster and green wash mitt.
scene_02.camera: Medium handheld reveal, then close-up passes over logo, bucket camo texture, mitt fibers, bottles, and foam blaster reservoir.
scene_02.product_visibility: Product must remain accurate: original colors, shapes, materials, proportions, and logo placement.

scene_03.role: visible product action and credible result
scene_03.visuals: Use the TORQ Foam Blaster 6 Pro with a garden hose to foam the car exterior. Show thick foam covering one door panel, then the green chenille wash mitt gliding in straight passes. Cut to Sticky Citrus Wheel Cleaner being used near a wheel and the green bristle wheel brush scrubbing the wheel face. Show blue microfiber towel wiping glass or dashboard, then a stable before/after-style angle of the same exterior panel looking clean and glossy in daylight. Avoid impossible sparkle effects.
scene_03.spoken_line: The camo bucket has the Dirt Trap, the foam blaster hooks up for a foamy wash, and everything I kept looking for is already in one spot.
scene_03.on_screen_action: Foam application, mitt wash, wheel brush scrub, microfiber wipe, final clean panel and wheel result.
scene_03.camera: Close-up foam texture, medium shot of washing motion, stable final proof shot from the same side angle as the dirty opening.
scene_03.product_visibility: Show the kit items in use without changing labels, adding accessories, or implying a pressure washer.

broll_coverage.visuals: Final driveway shot of the clean car with the full Chemical Guys kit neatly arranged beside the camo bucket. Creator picks up a blue microfiber towel and gives the clean panel one final wipe. Keep product logo visible on bucket and bottles.
broll_coverage.spoken_line: If you like washing your own car, this kit makes it feel organized.
broll_coverage.on_screen_action: Clean car reflection, organized kit arrangement, relaxed final wipe.
broll_coverage.camera: Handheld pullback from clean panel to kit, natural sunlight, realistic UGC finish.
broll_coverage.product_visibility: Full kit visible with camo bucket as the largest item.

allowed_claims: 16-piece car washing and interior detailing kit
includes exterior wash, wax, wheel, tire, glass, and interior cleaning products
includes microfiber towels, applicators, wash mitt, wheel brush, Dirt Trap, and camo bucket
helps make at-home car washing feel more organized

product_consistency_rules: Keep the blue, white, black, and gray camo bucket color unchanged.
Keep the large circular Chemical Guys logo on the bucket in the correct position.
Keep the green and black TORQ Foam Blaster 6 Pro with clear reservoir; do not turn it into a pressure washer.
Keep the green chenille wash mitt fuzzy and oversized relative to the hand.
Keep the blue microfiber towels and applicator pads blue.
Keep the black Dirt Trap disc with raised circular pattern.
Do not add accessories that are not part of the original kit.
Do not change product category, bottle shapes, labels, textures, proportions, or materials.
negative_visual_constraints: No platform UI, watermarks, subtitles, stickers, animated arrows, banners, or infographics.
No floating products or unrealistic foam explosions.
No extra lights, screens, buttons, connectors, spray guns, or pressure-washer equipment.
No altered bucket pattern or logo relocation.
No unsafe road washing scene; keep it in a driveway or garage setting.
